turns.user: A seller on Instagram asked me to pay 4,000 by UPI for a watch on 20 October 2026. After I paid they blocked me and the page is gone.
turns.reply:
**This looks like fraud, not a refund dispute.** If money was taken through a scam, call your bank first so it can try to freeze the payment, then call the cyber fraud helpline 1930 and file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. Please also speak to a lawyer. This tool handles only ordinary refund disputes.

I can't take this case further here.
